revisionDesc.change: Submit - lin2 added missed |subst|εισυχιο || lin12 removed diacritics from |subst| form || lin13 κατε̣νέγκουμεν => κατε̣νεγκοῦμεν, and it needs no regularization (cf. Gignac, Grammar II 287f.; κατενέγκομεν is also wrong) || lin15 corrected accent in |reg| form || lin16 ed. understands τούτον as τούτων, ‘the cargo of this barley’, but τούτων τῶν κριθῶν would be odd Greek; read τὸν γόμον τοῦτον, ‘this cargo of barley’, without assuming an error; entered as PN correction, and changed <:τούτων|reg|τούτον:> to τούτον, l. τούτων, i.e. sacrificing encoding propriety to clarity || lin16 added brackets to |reg| form || lin18 εἶμεν is strictly speaking correct and should not be regularized || lin22 corrected accent of πλήρες (one could add |reg| but I’d rather not to) | <:πρόκειται|reg|πρόκιτα[ι. .?] => <:πρόκειτα[ι]|reg|πρόκιτα[ι]:>. [.?] (but I don’t think [.?] is needed)
